regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative tape with only 2 of 22 themes trend-eligible (Coal and Banks) and a mean-reverting headline tag on Coal. The single validated edge (absolute-trend gate) did NOT hold on this market's history, so everything here is experimental/display and I lean low. Track record direction accuracy is only 0.337 — no view is a legitimate output.
emerging_watch: Watching whether a CONFIRMED handoff from Coal to Banks actually completes — observable condition: margin between Banks and Coal flips positive AND Banks' breadth stays above 0.9 for 5 consecutive sessions (current margin is only 0.065 with Coal still rank 1). If that condition holds, Coal's leadership is genuinely fading rather than noise.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are trend-eligible and rank 2 with strong durability (0.78) and breadth (0.944) — the healthiest structural trend in the detector — but crowding_z 1.74 is the highest in the set and marks size-down caution only, never a fade. Given gate_helps is false on this mean-reverting tape and direction accuracy is near coin-flip, the marginal edge in getting involved is low.
theses.dissent: Banks are the only theme with genuine trend structure and high breadth; avoiding them passes on the one genuinely durable leadership that could continue compounding through rotation.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS outperforms CSI 300 by 3% over any rolling 15-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the rank-1 leader but its headline hurst_tag is mean-revert, durability is a middling 0.54, and breadth is only 0.5 — leadership concentrated in a thin, fading trend. Momentum rank is an attention lens, not a buy signal, and this is a mean-reverting market where the gate has no drawdown edge.
theses.dissent: Coal's score of 1.095 is the strongest, it is NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.78), and a mean-revert tag on a leader could still mean it continues as a liquidity magnet in a one-narrative tape.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS makes a new 20-day high and holds above that level for 5 consecutive sessions
